rubric: The translation comes first, complete, with the same paragraphs, lists and order; names, numbers, dates and links unchanged.
Meaning and tone kept (formal stays formal, a joke stays a joke); idioms rendered as idioms; no content added, softened or summarised.
Formality choice (Sie/du, vous/tu) fits the reader and is named in a note when the source does not show it.
Notes only for real choices: a word with no exact match, an unclear source, the dialect used for Arabic.
Right-to-left output is clean: one paragraph per source paragraph, no mixed-language sentences.
